items.title: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut After Mixed Lumentum Deal Views
items.summary: The latest fair value estimate for Marvell Technology shifted from US$339.36 to US$317.60, signalling a reset in the implied price target used in some models. This revision sits against a backdrop of divided analyst views after the Lumentum acquisition announcement, where some see a larger AI and optical connectivity opportunity and others focus on dilution, integration risk and sector wide pressures.
